state.count_scope: 14 asset families: 5 Giro, 5 savings, 4 deposits. 5 named Outstanding Giro plus separate legacy Giro Keluar. 5 bank current-maturity loan families and 5 bank long-term loan families. Principal loans are excluded from bank-name compression.
state.previous_inconsistency: Previous Jev supported one savings GL in overall 488 count but chose retain five savings GL on a specific question. Resolve conditions, do not accept an earlier model answer as evidence.

savings_controlled.instructions: Assume five savings families differ ONLY by bank name, have identical accounting treatment, mandatory actual bank_account_id, per-account reconciliation and preserved unit attribution. Is bank-name-only GL duplication necessary?

criteria.merge: No: one savings GL with separate bank records preserves these controls.
criteria.keep: Yes: retain five GLs even under stated assumptions.

savings_evidence.instructions: Does the actual COA alone establish that all five savings accounts satisfy those identical-treatment assumptions?

criteria.no: No: account names alone do not establish restrictions/control differences.

outstanding_nature.instructions: Can Outstanding Giro be merged into bank cash or loan GL merely because the bank name matches?

criteria.no: No; distinguish issued uncleared instruments and their posting lifecycle from cash balances and loans.

outstanding_bank_names.instructions: If the five named Outstanding Giro families follow identical posting and clearing rules, with cheque register and bank_account_id, may bank-name variants share one clearing GL?

criteria.conditional_merge: Yes under these conditions; retain instrument-level reconciliation.
criteria.keep_names: No bank-name variants must always remain five GLs.

giro_keluar.instructions: Can legacy Giro Keluar be merged with Outstanding Giro without inspecting transactions and posting policy?

criteria.review: No: determine whether it is duplicate clearing, a different liability, or another lifecycle account.

cheque_policy.instructions: Do the names prove whether bank cash is reduced on issue or only on clearing and whether a clearing GL is needed?

criteria.unknown: No: inspect actual journal lifecycle and reconciliation practice.

loan_identity.instructions: Can five bank-name variants of current maturities be grouped into one current bank-loan GL, and five long-term variants into one long-term GL, with mandatory loan_facility_id and schedules, assuming equivalent accounting classes?

criteria.two: Yes two distinct provisional GL groups, separate facility records.
criteria.one: One GL for all current and long-term loans.

loan_keys.instructions: Is bank_account_id alone sufficient to identify loan obligations?

criteria.facility: No: separate loan_facility_id/contract, lender and schedules; payment bank is only a linked source.

principal.instructions: Can Principal loans be assumed bank loans because an earlier mapping grouped them together?

criteria.no: No: identify creditor and contractual nature first; exclude them from bank-name-only merges.

deposit_identity.instructions: Can bank-name variants of deposits share a GL when original maturity, restriction, liquidity and accounting treatment are equivalent, with individual deposit records?

criteria.conditional: Yes within the same verified classification; preserve deposit_id and schedules.
criteria.all: All deposits may share cash-equivalent GL regardless of restrictions.
criteria.names: Each bank must always have a separate deposit GL.

deposit_classification.instructions: Can four Time Deposit names alone establish one final cash-equivalent/current/noncurrent/restricted GL classification?

criteria.no: No: need original maturity, purpose, liquidity, risk and restrictions plus applicable reporting policy.

deposit_key.instructions: Which key preserves multiple placements at the same bank with different terms?

criteria.instrument: deposit_id per placement linked to bank and unit, with original term, maturity, restrictions and rollover history.

criteria.scenario: Arithmetic for retaining three provisional asset families, not proof of final classifications.

count_476.instructions: If asset families14->3, named Outstanding Giro5->1 (Giro Keluar remains separate), current bank loans5->1 and long-term bank loans5->1, what count follows?

count_deposit_splits.instructions: If deposits require k verified GL classes, under the same other reductions, how should count change?

criteria.formula: 475+k: 476 if k=1,477 if k=2,etc.; legacy Giro Keluar still separate.
